reviews.note: Dated to a real astronomical event, so the date is fixed even though the content is loose.
Dates the origin to 2020 and adds the escalation path: chickens, then turkeys, then cattle. The cattle stage is the untested part.
Adds the Thanksgiving turkey shortfall, which is checkable in a way the general claim is not.
Filed as its own claim: this is the standing explanation for why dated words arrive years late, and he works it out on air here using the chicken word as the example.
Left unsure because it is someone else's date that he explicitly declines to endorse, while offering a sensory detail that seems to support it.
April, from a now dead source, matched to the warmth he felt. The corroboration is circular: he takes another's date as confirming his impression.
Follows on from the Billy Brim Christmas word, so billy-brim-christmas-gifts and this are the same thread continuing.
Near verbatim repeat of AWpWnczIhdQ@223 from October 2024. The prayer sessions reuse fixed blocks.
Present anxiety read as a prophecy already fulfilled, which is a pattern worth noting rather than a claim.
Near verbatim repeat of the October 2023 grid prayer, same metros. Sixteen months and the wording has not moved.
The passage undercuts itself usefully: the same urgency was reported forty one years earlier, which he raises himself.
Contrary evidence ruled out in advance: do not be moved when the loved one acts against the word you were given.
Worth keeping for the opposite reason: here he rejects the not-enough-faith explanation that his conditional claims elsewhere depend on.
Structurally important: a stated intention to stop publishing some warnings, which means absence from the record is not evidence of absence of a claim.
Claims the 2022 origin and points at empty egg shelves as the fulfilment. The mass culling half is a matter of public record and did occur.
He declines the prophet label while continuing to make dated calls. Relevant to how the record should be scored and to grace-for-missed-words.
The exemption clause for the plague: believers are delivered as Israel was from Egypt.
States the purpose plainly: finances come over to the church so it is ready for what is coming.
The most specific timing the plague thread ever gets: starts in the fall, three month window into spring, with 2027 named as what they are getting ready for.
Gives the curve: late February to May the bulk, June to August fading.

Marked contradiction on purpose. The calendar ran backwards and he says he does not understand why, which makes the same four passages readable as either a 2025-26 or a 2026-27 sequence. The timing cannot be pinned without choosing a direction he never chose.
